title: SAFER-INSTRUCT: Aligning Language Models with Automated Preference Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model generations for discrimination, prejudice, and stereotyping using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4 and Claude 3) on prompts derived from a hate speech corpus targeting various groups (e.g., race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation).
Analyzing MT-bench qualitative outputs and scores to observe that GPT-4 as an automated judge disproportionately favors models fine-tuned on its own generated data (such as the Alpaca + SI model).
